q1.explanationZh: reception 名词“接受；接待”，也可指“欢迎会”，动词是 receive。

q2.explanationZh: reception 加表示人的后缀 -ist，receptionist“接待员”。

q3.explanationZh: recipe 名词“食谱；窍门”，结尾是 -pe，读 /pi/。

q4.explanationZh: recite 去 e 加 -ation 构成名词 recitation“背诵；朗读”。

q5.explanationZh: recite 动词“背诵；朗诵”，recite a poem“背诵一首诗”。

q6.explanationZh: recognise 的名词形式 recognition“认出；承认”，beyond recognition“认不出来”。

q7.explanationZh: recognise 是英式拼写，recognize 是美式拼写，两种都对。

q8.explanationZh: recommend“推荐，建议”，注意一个 c、两个 m；recommend doing sth.。

q9.explanationZh: record 作名词重音在前 /ˈrekɔːd/，作动词重音在后 /rɪˈkɔːd/。

q10.explanationZh: record 加 -ing 构成名词 recording“录音；录制品”。

q11.explanationZh: recover“恢复；找回”，recover from“从……中恢复”。

q12.explanationZh: recreate“消遣，娱乐”，recreate oneself with sth.“以……消遣”。

q13.explanationZh: recreate 的名词形式 recreation“娱乐；消遣”。

q14.explanationZh: re-（再）+ cycle（循环）= recycle“回收利用”。

q15.explanationZh: red 既是形容词“红色的”，也是名词“红色”。

q17.explanationZh: refer 不及物动词，常用 refer to“提到；参考”，过去式双写 r：referred。

q18.explanationZh: refer 的名词形式 reference“参考”，reference book“参考书”。

q19.explanationZh: reflect“反映；反射”，reflect on“反思”，名词 reflection。

q20.explanationZh: re-（重新）+ form（形成）= reform“改革”，名词动词同形。

q21.explanationZh: re-（再）+ fresh（新鲜的）= refresh“使恢复精神”。

q22.explanationZh: refrigerator“冰箱”，口语中常简称 fridge。

q23.explanationZh: refuge“避难所”加 -ee 表示人，refugee“难民”。

q24.explanationZh: refund 动词名词同形：“退款；退还”，a full refund“全额退款”。

q25.explanationZh: refuse 去 e 加 -al 构成名词 refusal“拒绝”。

q26.explanationZh: refuse“拒绝”，refuse to do sth.“拒绝做某事”。

q27.explanationZh: regard 作动词“看待”，regard ... as ...；作名词复数 regards 表示“问候”。

q28.explanationZh: regarding 是介词“关于”，相当于 about。

q29.explanationZh: regard 加 -less（没有）构成 regardless，常用 regardless of“不管”。

q30.explanationZh: region 名词“地区”，形容词 regional“地区的”。

q31.explanationZh: register“登记；注册”，名词动词同形。

q32.explanationZh: regret“遗憾；后悔”，过去式双写 t：regretted。

q33.explanationZh: regular“有规律的；定期的”，反义词 irregular，副词 regularly。

q34.explanationZh: regulate 动词“控制；调节”，名词 regulation。

q35.explanationZh: regulate 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 regulation“规章；规则”。

q36.explanationZh: re- + in- + force（力量）= reinforce“加强”。

q38.explanationZh: re-（再）+ juven（年轻）+ -ate（使）= rejuvenate“使恢复青春”。

q39.explanationZh: “背诵一首诗”= recite a poem，poem 是可数名词，用 a。

q40.explanationZh: recognise ... as ...“承认……是……；认出……是……”，as 后接身份或性质。

q41.explanationZh: a matter of record“正式记录；有案可查的事”，record 用单数。

q42.explanationZh: keep a record of sth.“把某事记录下来”，介词用 of。

q43.explanationZh: off the record“不公开发表的；非正式的”。

q44.explanationZh: on record“记录在案”，record 前不加冠词。

q45.explanationZh: recover from“从（疾病、打击等）中恢复”，介词用 from。

q46.explanationZh: reduce sth. to sth.“使某物变为……”，介词用 to。

q47.explanationZh: reduce sb. to sth./doing“使某人沦落到（做）……”，to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

q48.explanationZh: refer to“提到；参考；把……归因于”，to 是介词。

q49.explanationZh: “参考书”= reference book，reference 作定语。

q50.explanationZh: refuse to do sth.“拒绝做某事”，refuse 后接不定式。

q51.explanationZh: give one’s regards to sb.“向某人问候”，“问候”要用复数 regards。

q52.explanationZh: regard sb./sth. as ...“把某人/某物看作……”，as 后接名词或形容词。

q53.explanationZh: regret doing sth.“后悔做过某事”；regret to do 表示“遗憾地要做（还没做）”。

q54.explanationZh: has 后用现在完成时，填过去分词 recorded“录制了”。

q55.explanationZh: recreate oneself with sth.“以……消遣”，主语 I，一般现在时用原形。

q56.explanationZh: be red with crying“哭红了”，were 后用形容词 red。

q57.explanationZh: 冷饮让我“恢复了精神”，讲过去的事用过去式 refreshed。

q58.explanationZh: reject“拒绝”，叙述过去的事用过去式 rejected。

q59.explanationZh: return the product“退货”，can 后用动词原形；for a full refund“获得全额退款”。

q60.explanationZh: regard ... as ...“把……看作……”，主语 He 是第三人称单数，用 regards。

q61.explanationZh: regarding 是介词“关于”，a letter regarding ... “关于……的信”。

q62.explanationZh: with regret“遗憾地”，介词 with 后用名词 regret。

q63.explanationZh: 修饰名词 performances 用形容词 regular“定期的”。

q64.sampleAnswer: There is no need to bury yourself in self-pity or regrets, for it is never too late to turn your life around, regardless of the mistakes you made in the past.
references: There is no need to bury yourself in self-pity or regrets, for it is never too late to turn your life around, regardless of the mistakes you made in the past.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “无论……”= regardless of + 名词；“为时不晚”= it is never too late to do。

q65.sampleAnswer: The experience not only broadened my horizons but also reinforced my determination to study harder.
references: The experience not only broadened my horizons but also reinforced my determination to study harder.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “坚定决心”= reinforce one’s determination；not only ... but also ... 连接两个谓语，都用过去式。

q66.sampleAnswer: He referred to his teacher when he talked about his teaching experience.
references: He referred to his teacher when he talked about his teaching experience.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “提及”= refer to，过去式双写 r：referred。

q67.sampleAnswer: They’ve reduced the prices in the shop, so it’s a good time to buy.
references: They’ve reduced the prices in the shop, so it’s a good time to buy.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “已经降低了”用现在完成时 have reduced；“是……的好时候”= it’s a good time to do。

q68.sampleAnswer: With the help of the police, they recovered the lost money.
references: With the help of the police, they recovered the lost money.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “拿回”= recover，过去式 recovered；“在……的帮助下”= with the help of。

q69.sampleAnswer: He tried to rejuvenate himself by taking regular exercise.
references: He tried to rejuvenate himself by taking regular exercise.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “让自己恢复年轻活力”= rejuvenate oneself；“通过……”= by doing。

q70.sampleAnswer: There is no doubt that the choice of school reflects the parents’ hope for their children.
references: There is no doubt that the choice of school reflects the parents’ hope for their children.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “毫无疑问”= There is no doubt that ...；主语 the choice 是单数，用 reflects。

q71.sampleAnswer: The reform and opening policy has brought us a rich and colourful life.
references: The reform and opening policy has brought us a rich and colourful life.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: “改革开放政策”= the reform and opening policy；“带来了”用现在完成时 has brought。

q72.sampleAnswer: The reason why the book is highly recommended is that it provides us with hope and inspiration.
references: The reason why the book is highly recommended is that it provides us with hope and inspiration.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q72.explanationZh: “备受推崇”= be highly recommended；The reason why ... is that ... 表语从句用 that。

q73.sampleAnswer: There is no denying that China’s advanced technology of high-speed railway has been recognised by almost all the countries in the world.
references: There is no denying that China’s advanced technology of high-speed railway has been recognised by almost all the countries in the world.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q73.explanationZh: “不可否认”= There is no denying that ...；“已受到承认”用现在完成时的被动语态 has been recognised。
